findings.title: Starvation permanente no backlog de pending_activation
findings.cause: A bounded scan ordered by converted_user_id ASC repeatedly selected the same blocked prefix; blocked leads remain pending, so later eligible users could remain unvisited indefinitely.
required_remediation: Use a bounded traversal strategy that guarantees progress beyond blocked users.
Add a regression with more pending leads than the limit, a fully blocked prefix, and a later eligible lead.
Prove repeated reconciliation eventually reaches eligible pending leads beyond the prefix.
Refreeze the material candidate and produce a fresh independent-audit handoff.
